newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in lacklustre trade with most traders sidelined due to the continued absence of fresh incentives, dealers said on Wednesday.
They said the market is expected to continue hovering around current levels until later in the week.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on some position adjustments. Some people are waiting for Thursday's release of the (U.S. May) retail sales and Friday's (U.S. May) producer price index data, for fresh clues to market direction," he said.
"But I don't think there will be much impact unless the numbers are way off market expectations," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Wednesday/Thursday and Thursday/Friday were were unchanged from Tuesday's common 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent, respectively. Week-fixed eased 1/16 percentage point to 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16, nine-months unchanged at 6-1/16 5-15/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 6-3/16 6-1/16 percent.
